# Journal 1.4.0 upgrade fixtures

These SQLite databases were generated by the `v1.4.0` tagged Journal source,
not by changing `PRAGMA user_version` on a newer database. Both report schema
version 1. The plaintext fixture also contains deliberately stale Cloud Backup
tables and a trigger, exercising their safe removal in migration 4.

`journal-1.4.0-locked-encrypted.db` was locked after generation. Its fixture
master password is `fixture password`; it is test data only.
